metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: PEDMET crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C1 H18 Nd3 Ni3 O115 Sb3 W28 16-,5(K1 1+),40(H2 O1),11(Na1 1+). From the CIF bond table, W1 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W2 (W) has 4 O neighbors; W3 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W4 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W5 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W6 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W7 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W8 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W9 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W10 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W11 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W12 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W13 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W14 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W15 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W16 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W17 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W18 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W19 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W20 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W21 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W22 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W23 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W24 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W25 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W26 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W27 (W) has 6 O neighbors; W28 (W) has 6 O neighbors; Nd1 (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Nd2 (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Nd3 (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Ni1 (Ni) has 6 O neighbors; Ni2 (Ni) has 6 O neighbors; Ni3 (Ni) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 81 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.280-5.048 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 89.41-161.59°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula K5Na11[Pr3(H2O)3Ni3(H2O)6(SbW9O33)3(WO4)(CO3)]·40H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 3 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 6 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
